instruction: Candid medium shot of two smiling judo practitioners sitting side-by-side on a gym mat. On the left, the dark-haired man (R2) in a white gi and black belt holds up a smartphone to take a selfie, his left arm draped over the shoulder of the blonde-haired man (R1) on the right. R1, also wearing a white gi and black belt, smiles happily towards the phone's camera. The background features large windows with soft natural light illuminating the indoor training hall.
